question:
Create a new KiCad project named b14 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Build an ESP-12/ESP8266 IoT power-meter interface board, powered from a two-pin 5 V input through an AP1117-3.3 regulator module. The light sensor, OLED, microSD reader and FTDI interface are external modules represented by connectors; do not replace them with bare IC circuits.
Firmware assignments are light-sensor digital output = GPIO4; OLED SCL/SDA = GPIO2/GPIO5; SD CS/MOSI/CLK/MISO = GPIO16/GPIO13/GPIO14/GPIO12. GPIO15 is grounded. Provide a GPIO0-to-ground programming button with a 10k pull-up, and join the module's reset and enable signals. The sensor connector is DO, GND, 3.3 V; OLED is 3.3 V, GND, SCL, SDA; SD reader is 3.3 V, CS, MOSI, CLK, MISO, GND; FTDI is adapter RX, adapter TX, 5 V, GND, with UART TX/RX crossed to the ESP. The supplied footprints describe these module interfaces.
Local dependencies: Use the project-local footprint library in lib/ under the project directory (IPM_KiCad_footprint_library.pretty); use standard KiCad libraries for everything else.
